# FactSmith

> FactSmith: voice-first BI for SMBs. A Fact Layer turns your data into governed facts and industry KPIs -- ask by voice, one flat cost, unlimited users.

Ask is available now. Easy Data -- turning messy sources into a dimensional foundation -- is in early development; the two are halves of one job, not the same stage. The product reports on Kimball-style dimensional warehouses: the evaluation copy runs against PostgreSQL, and SQL Server is on the adapter path for a customer warehouse but not what the package proves end to end today. One company, one source database, one deployment -- not a shared cloud holding everybody else's numbers.

Contact: factsmith@outlook.com

## Product

- [What is FactSmith](https://www.factsmith.co.za/what-is-factsmith/): what it is, who it is for, what you do with it
- [How it works](https://www.factsmith.co.za/how-it-works/): connect, agree meaning, ask, keep
- [Facts](https://www.factsmith.co.za/facts/): some answers are a standard formula this warehouse can compute; an administrator still vouches for everything else
- [Trust and security](https://www.factsmith.co.za/trust-and-security/): permissions enforced beneath the AI
- [Deployment](https://www.factsmith.co.za/deployment/): what standing up an evaluation copy involves
- [FAQ](https://www.factsmith.co.za/faq/)
